text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marking the milestone of that year— the 
day of the SWBC had finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite all the twists and turns along the 
way, standing on this stage is the result 
of the Three Goddesses' support and the 
Trainers standing steadfastly by their 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And together, you and <chrname> have run 
side-by-side to make it all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A heated race that tests the true worth of 
the Umamusume sprinting through the 
present and the Trainer who supported her 
is finally about to begin...!
